title: Sci-Fi
story: Blast off into a cheerful retro future of rockets, saucers and glowing gadgets.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A classic finned rocket with a pointed nose cone, round porthole windows and three tail fins.
cards.hero_colors: silver, red nose and fins, small yellow flame

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round flying saucer with a glass dome on top and a ring of small lights around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: silver gray, green glass dome, small orange lights

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A round planet with a wide tilted ring around its middle.
cards.hero_colors: orange and cream planet, pale yellow ring, small blue crater

cards.name: Meteor
cards.subject: A lumpy round rock with a few craters and a short tail of flames behind it.
cards.hero_colors: brown gray rock, small bright orange flames

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round helmet with a big curved glass visor and a collar ring at the bottom.
cards.hero_colors: white helmet, gold tinted visor, small red collar stripe

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A slanted console with rows of round buttons, a lever and two round dials.
cards.hero_colors: light gray console, red and yellow buttons, small green dial

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A small six-wheeled rover with a boxy body, a dish antenna and a tiny solar panel.
cards.hero_colors: white body, black wheels, small orange antenna

cards.name: Telescope
cards.subject: A long tube telescope on a three-legged stand, with an eyepiece at the back.
cards.hero_colors: cream tube, brown wood legs, small brass ring

cards.name: Radio Dish
cards.subject: A big white satellite dish on a tall base, tilted up to the sky.
cards.hero_colors: white dish, gray base, small red light

cards.name: Moon Base
cards.subject: A glass dome house with a round tunnel and a small ladder, sitting beside a crater.
cards.hero_colors: white dome, light blue glass, small yellow door

source: the final sci-fi cards, redrawn from Blender blockouts
